items.title: Minor "Ram" Hall Interview, 1958-09-02
items.q: So he picked up a fellow by the name of Jones. Well, Davey Jones. ... He was playing saxophone there. So after he joined the band...

ctx.x: So some man up there, I forget his name, he wanted a Dixland band to work at a place called Pekrola Dance Hall on Market Street. I have a picture of that. Yeah, so he got in touch with these guys, so we had to add another man to the band to make eight pieces. So he picked up a fellow by the name of Jones. Well, Davey Jones.
